changes.schedule: Every Friday, starting Fri, Dec 11, 2026. Meet 5:30 pm at the rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St; it rolls at 6:00 pm and finishes about 7:45 pm three blocks south, over coffee.
changes.description: A queer social night ride through Phoenix's history, hosted by Robert Castan of Cycle for Change. About 15 flat miles from the 2018 rainbow crosswalk at Central and Portland: down Washington Street on the route of the first Pride march in 1981, through Encanto and Willo to the Melrose Curve (the one stop), Steele Indian School Park, the lit Grand Canal path and Coronado, and back on the old Fruit Loop bar circuit to coffee. No-drop, free.
